tldr: Black Moon Lilith conjunct the Midheaven.
body: The raw, autonomous self is bound up with your public role; you can't comfortably play a sanitized part and are pulled to work on your own terms, often as an outsider.
business: A distinctive public voice that won't be managed.
shadow: Clashes with authority, or quietly sabotaging your own standing to stay free.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
